name: Rough.js
role: Hand-drawn, sketchy rendering of shapes and paths to Canvas or SVG
summary: Small library (under 9kB gzipped) that draws lines, curves, arcs, polygons, circles, ellipses and SVG paths with a hand-sketched look. Driven by rough.canvas or rough.svg; output is Canvas pixels or SVG nodes. Its strength is the sketch aesthetic as a drop-in layer. Not an animation or scene library. Development has been quiet since late 2023.
use_when: Whiteboard or diagram look on shapes and paths
Over Paper.js or Two.js when the sketchy style is the point
Adding a hand-drawn style to SVG output that GSAP then animates
Small footprint, no scene graph needed
avoid_when: Interactive objects or animation loop: Konva or Two.js
Clean geometric vector output: Two.js or SVG directly
Diagram layout from text: Mermaid CLI or Graphviz
notes: 2026-10-26: A seed option for deterministic jitter exists in the library to our knowledge but was not on roughjs.com; confirm in the API wiki before relying on it. Release date of 4.6.6 not retrieved.

assessment.rationale: npm latest is 4.6.6; the repository's last commit is 2023-11-20, about 35 months ago, so maintenance is slow rather than dead. MIT. Unique sketch-style niche among A1 tools.
